description.zh: 查询监控项的结束时间。
description.en: The end time of the query.

description.zh:
返回监控数据的每页大小，用于分页查询。
> 监控项为instance_in_traffic和instance_out_traffic时，最大值为100。
description.en:
The number of entries to return on each page. This parameter is used for paged queries.

> The maximum value is 100 when the metric is \`instance\_in\_traffic\` or \`instance\_out\_traffic\`.

description.zh: 用来标记当前开始读取的位置。置空表示从头开始。
description.en: The token that marks the start of the next page of results. If you leave this parameter empty, the query starts from the beginning.

description.zh:

description.en:
The statistical period of the monitoring data.
Unit: seconds.
